pluginYml:
name: AuthMe
version: '1.0-SNAPSHOT'
main: com.hizeric.logincore.LoginCore
description: Securely verifies Mojang account ownership and automates AuthMe logins on offline-mode Paper servers.
authors: [hizeric]
api-version: '26.3'
load: POSTWORLD
depend: [packetevents]
libraries:
  - org.xerial:sqlite-jdbc:3.50.3.0
commands:
  logincore:
    description: login-core administration
    usage: /logincore <status|exempt|migrate>
  login:
    description: Log in to an offline account
    usage: /login <password>
  register:
    description: Register an offline account
    usage: /register <password> <password>
  changepassword:
    description: Change your offline account password
    usage: /changepassword <old> <new>
permissions:
  logincore.admin:
    description: Allows administration of login-core
    default: op
